### What's New in AuraMusic v3.4.0:
- Reliable PackageInstaller Updates: Replaced the old intent-based installer with Android's modern PackageInstaller session API — the same method used by Telegram, F-Droid, and APKPure. The system install confirmation now appears reliably on every phone and ROM (Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, etc.).
- Smart Update Cache: Downloaded APKs are preserved across app restarts. If you downloaded but didn't finish installing, you'll see 'Install Now' immediately instead of re-downloading.
- Clear Error Messages: If an install fails, you now see exactly why (storage full, signing mismatch, install blocked) instead of silent failure.
- Skip Version: Tired of a specific update prompt? Tap 'Skip this version' and it won't bother you again (mandatory security updates still show).
- Security Hardening: HTTPS enforcement, network security config, safe URL parsing, and input sanitization across all endpoints.
- Concurrency Fixes: Hardened audio output, casting, downloads, and repository operations for thread safety.
- UI & Accessibility: Improved player controls, navigation bars, theme consistency, keyboard navigation, and screen reader support.
- Desktop Improvements: Search pagination, keyboard shortcuts, replay navigation, and accessibility enhancements.
- CI/CD: Hardened build configs, GitHub Actions workflows, release signing, and documentation.
